settings.title: ATHENA PRO
settings.subtitle: Available in leatherette & fabric
settings.text: The Athena Series allows you to personalize your comfort. Choose from our premium signature leatherette or fabric upholstery, offering you the option of sleek sophistication or cozy elegance. Your chair, your way.

settings.title: Dynamic ergonomics for every mode
settings.text: Built for long sessions of gaming, work, and creation — delivering adaptive comfort, scientific support, and lasting performance.

settings.title: From intense gaming to deep focus work — always in perfect balance
settings.text: Athena Pro keeps your posture active and supported through every mode. Whether you're battling in-game, designing, or deep in spreadsheets, the seat adjusts and moves with you.

settings.title:
Soft yet supportive
– the perfect balance
settings.text: Why settle for stiff, uncomfortable foam when our upgraded ultra-soft memory foam offers superior softness and lasting resilience? It cradles you in cloud-like comfort while providing the perfect support, designed to keep you comfortable, focused, and supported for years to come.

settings.title: Engineered for durability
settings.text: Our dual-layer design combines memory foam with a high-density polyurethane core infused with carbon and silver ions. This structure provides slow but responsive rebound, superior shape retention, odor control, and antibacterial protection—all fully REACH compliant for safe, long-term use.

settings.title:
Integrated 4-way dynamic
lumbar support
settings.subtitle: Adjustable lumbar support
settings.text: The lumbar support is the heart of any great gaming chair, and ours is exceptional. With adjustable height and depth, it ensures a perfect fit for your spine, delivering ultimate comfort and support. The backrest is enhanced with memory foam, offering even more softness and comfort while providing superior support for long gaming sessions.

settings.left_text: Tailored lower back support to reduce pressure and maintain spinal alignment.
settings.right_text: Now featuring KGS factory gas lifts, SGS certified, and offering up to class 4 pressure. With top-tier materials and exceptional performance in load support, drop, rotation, and impact tests, it’s built for long-lasting durability.

settings.title:
Precise arm support relieve
shoulder & arm stress
settings.subtitle: 4-Way dynamic armrest
settings.text: Our 4-Way Dynamic Armrests are engineered to support your natural posture, moving seamlessly in every direction to reduce stress on your muscles and joints. These armrests provide the perfect alignment to keep you supported and comfortable.

settings.text_1:
Adaptive Neckrest
Steady support in every position.
settings.text_2:
Dynamic Backrest
No gaps. No strain. Just reliable support.
settings.text_3:
Nexgen Eco Leatherette
Luxury.Endurance.Sustainability. All in one.

settings.title: Versatile comfort
settings.text: Built for gaming, lounging, napping, and more. Adjust to any position effortlessly with a simple lever pulland push.

settings.title: Maximized relaxation
settings.text: Find your perfect gaming stance with our multi-tilt mechanism.Adjust tension, lock your angle, and playin ultimate comfort.

settings.heading: 1. How does Athena Pro compare to other ergonomic gaming chairs?
settings.content: Compared to most gaming chairs in its class, Athena Pro offers superior adjustability, reinforced materials, and higher comfort ratings, making it a preferred choice for serious gamers.

settings.heading: 2. What type of users is the Athena Pro best suited for?
settings.content: It’s designed for competitive gamers, streamers, and professionals who spend long hours seated and demand maximum ergonomic support.

settings.heading: 3. Can the Athena Pro be used as an office chair?
settings.content: Absolutely. Its ergonomic structure and premium padding make it ideal for both gaming and professional work setups.

settings.heading: 4. Is the Athena Pro suitable for big and tall users?
settings.content: Yes, the Athena Pro gaming chair is built to support a wide range of body types, including big and tall users. It features one size that adapts to most body shapes, along with adjustable height, tilt, and armrests to create a personalized fit for long gaming or work sessions.

settings.heading: 5. Can the Athena Pro improve posture and reduce fatigue?
settings.content: Yes. As a top-rated gaming chair, its ergonomic design aligns your spine, supports your lower back, and reduces strain, helping you stay comfortable and focused during prolonged gaming or work sessions.

settings.heading: 6. Does the Athena Pro come with a warranty?
settings.content: Every Athena Pro includes a 3-year warranty, just like all Blacklyte gaming chairs. For added protection, you can join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a €10 cashback.
